display_name: Candy Collapse Arenas - Godot JSON Map Pack
description: Ten candy-themed Hole.io-inspired arena specifications for a Godot map generator. Includes PNG references, normalized regions, blockers, pathways, spawn rules, hazards and difficulty tuning.
import_order: load manifest, then each map JSON, then instantiate props/colliders based on regions/pathways/blockers/spawn_rules

maps.summary: Open frosting meadow with lollipop trees, gumdrop bushes, cupcake huts, jellybean patches and icing ponds.
Candy orchard with giant gumdrop clusters, lollipop trees, jellybean trails, caramel puddles and cupcake sheds.
Structured candy-town plaza with waffle streets, peppermint roundabouts, striped awnings, fountains and candy-cane dividers.
Festive cookie-and-donut carnival with circular plazas, cookie booths, frosting tents, candy lights and donut rides.
Candy district split by glossy chocolate canals, wafer bridges, marshmallow docks, cookie barges and fudge embankments.
Marshmallow lagoons with fluffy islands, candy boardwalks, jelly docks, syrup pools and puffy bridges.
Busy candy crossroads with jellybean boulevards, candy-cane medians, peppermint traffic circles, gummy parking lots and shop blocks.
Whimsical candy factory with taffy conveyors, licorice pipes, gum machines, fondant mixers, syrup vats and wrapped-candy crates.
Dense maze of twisting licorice walls, peppermint gates, cookie courtyards, candy vaults and shortcut loops.
Grand candy fortress with central sugar castle, layered courtyards, chocolate moat sections, wafer bridges, peppermint towers and royal candy gardens.
